pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Look up Hanging Lights, then choose attachment points. The goal records owning the strand and placing a lantern, not the length of a finished string.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Craft a lantern and crouch-right-click to equip it in a supported accessory slot. Carry a belt lantern while leaving the offhand available.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Equip a lantern with the required accessory and dynamic-light integration installed. Get moving illumination and a swinging third-person lantern.
